news.title: Superstar Mahesh Babu shares praise for Fahadh Faasil's upcoming film
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu took to social media to share his thoughts after watching an early screening of Don't Trouble The Trouble. He lauded the movie as a warm, well-crafted, and deeply moving entertainer ahead of its theatrical release on October 2, 2026. The project is presented by ace director S.S. Rajamouli and directed by Shashank Yeleti.

news.title: Telugu version of Nivin Pauly and Soori's Sanchari delayed
news.summary: The Telugu theatrical release of Sanchari, starring Nivin Pauly and Soori, has been pushed back from its original October 1 date. Directed by Ram and featuring music by Yuvan Shankar Raja, the dubbed version's premiere was put on hold due to title-related complications. Producers will announce a revised release schedule soon.

news.title: Mahesh Babu reviews Don't Trouble The Trouble and praises the team
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu watched a special screening of the upcoming Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble, directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti and presented by S.S. Rajamouli. Taking to X, the actor described the project as a beautifully complete and heartwarming cinematic experience. He also commended lead actor Fahadh Faasil and the entire crew behind the production.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika highlight untold history for Ranabaali
news.summary: In the second episode of their promotional docu-series, Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika discussed lesser-known historical facts tied to their upcoming movie Ranabaali. They shared that the British introduced railways primarily to expedite the transport of Indian resources to ports rather than for local infrastructure. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the film is scheduled to hit screens on October 16.

news.title: Maadhav's Debut Venture Maremma Locks Dual OTT Platforms
news.summary: Tollywood newcomer Maadhav Bhupathiraju's rural drama Maremma is scheduled for an online debut on Aha and Amazon Prime Video. The film, which originally arrived in cinemas on September 10, 2026, will stream on both platforms starting October 9, 2026. Directed by Manchala Nagaraj and produced by Mayur Reddy Bandaru, the project features an ensemble cast including Deepa Balu and Vikas Vasishta.

news.title: Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's Fauji Holds Off on New Release Schedule
news.summary: The makers of Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's upcoming film Fauji are taking their time to finalize a revised theatrical calendar following multiple postponements. With a significant portion of the production remaining, Prabhas needs to dedicate over 60 working days to wrap up the shoot. Consequently, the team is avoiding any release date announcements for now, though promotional content is anticipated for the actor's birthday on October 23.

news.title: Star-Studded Cast Joins Salman Khan and Vamshi Paidipally's Action Flick
news.summary: Director Vamshi Paidipally's action-heavy project featuring Salman Khan has assembled a massive ensemble cast, including Nayanthara as the female lead alongside prominent actors like Arvind Swamy, Jackie Shroff, Anil Kapoor, Rajpal Yadav, Ronit Roy, and Seema Biswas. Bankrolled by Dil Raju under Sri Venkateswara Creations, the movie features Salman as an unconventional cop and is halfway through its production. The makers are eyeing a grand theatrical arrival during Eid 2027.

news.title: Nani Travels to Andhra Pradesh to Revive The Paradise Box Office Numbers
news.summary: To counter a slowing trend in theatre occupancy across Andhra Pradesh, actor Nani has arrived in Gannavaram to spearhead an aggressive promotional campaign. He is slated to interact directly with fans in Vijayawada, Guntur, and Ongole during this extended holiday stretch. The core team is counting on these personal appearances to ignite fresh momentum for the movie.

news.title: Chandoo Mondeti's Hindi Directorial Debut Linked to Sanjay Leela Bhansali
news.summary: Tollywood filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti is heading to Bollywood for an upcoming venture starring Akshay Kumar and Rana Daggubati. Recent updates indicate that Sanjay Leela Bhansali will produce the film under Bhansali Productions, while also contributing the core storyline. This high-profile collaboration has quickly generated massive online anticipation ahead of its filming schedule.

news.title: Ravi Teja Starrer Irumudi Secures Top Spot on Netflix Global Chart
news.summary: Shiva Nirvana's directorial venture Irumudi, starring Ravi Teja alongside Sai Kumar and Priya Bhavani Shankar, has clinched the number one rank on Netflix's Global Top 10 list for non-English films. The Telugu feature pulled in 3.4 million views during its first full week on the platform, bringing its cumulative digital viewership to 6.8 million. The movie is streaming globally with audio options in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada following its successful theatrical run.

news.title: Fresh OTT Streaming Lineup Hits Screens This Weekend
news.summary: Multiple multilingual movies and web series are making their digital debuts this weekend. Notable Telugu titles like Romanchakam and multi-language projects are heading to major streaming platforms over the next few days.

news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee's Raaka Eyed as a Two-Part Release
news.summary: Makers of the high-budget global project Raaka, directed by Atlee and starring Allu Arjun, are reportedly considering a two-part release strategy. The ambitious film features an ensemble cast including Deepika Padukone, Mrunal Thakur, and Rashmika Mandanna, backed by Sun Pictures.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Hits Breakeven Milestone in Nizam
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed word of mouth, Nani and Srikanth Odela's action drama The Paradise has successfully touched the breakeven mark in the Nizam territory within six days. The movie has grossed approximately Rs. 170 crore worldwide while lead actor Nani actively continues promotional tours.

news.title: NTR Confirms Full Recovery from Shoulder Surgery and Preps for Dragon
news.summary: Actor NTR announced at a recent event that he has fully recuperated from his shoulder surgery and is gearing up to resume shooting for Prashanth Neel's Dragon. Director Prashanth Neel aims to complete production by February, keeping the film on track for a June 2027 theatrical release.

news.title: Jr NTR's Promotional Boost for Fahadh Faasil Starrer
news.summary: Jr NTR stepped in to support the promotional campaign for the Fahadh Faasil starrer Don’t Trouble The Trouble, produced by SS Karthikeya. His appearance immediately drew widespread social media attention and shifted the spotlight onto the upcoming October 2 release. Industry experts note that while this publicity provides a strong initial push, strong word-of-mouth will ultimately dictate its theatrical success.

news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee's Massive Project Eyes Multi-Part Launch
news.summary: Icon Star Allu Arjun is heavily invested in his upcoming high-budget spectacle directed by Atlee and backed by Sun Pictures. Given the lavish investments and international production standards, the makers are actively discussing a two-part release strategy stretching across December 2027 and 2028. The film boasts a stellar ensemble cast featuring Deepika Padukone, Rashmika Mandanna, Mrunal Thakur, Janhvi Kapoor, and Aishwarya Lekshmi.

news.title: Sreeleela Boards Rajinikanth's Dharman
news.summary: Actress Sreeleela has officially joined the cast of the Tamil film Dharman, starring Rajinikanth and directed by Ashwath Marimuthu. She was recently spotted arriving at the film's Mysuru shooting location alongside co-stars Ram Pothineni and Raashi Khanna. Produced by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, the movie features music by Anirudh Ravichander.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya Gears Up for Milestone 25th Project
news.summary: As actor Naga Chaitanya prepares for the December release of his high-budget mystical thriller Vrushakarma directed by Karthik Dandu Varma, preparations are underway for his landmark 25th feature. Producer Bunny Vas and presenter Allu Aravind, who previously teamed up with the actor for Thandel, are backing this new venture. Director Clax will helm the movie, which is scheduled for an official launch in October following a positive response to the narrative.

news.title: Rumors Hint at a Police Officer Persona for Allu Arjun in Lokesh Kanagaraj Collaboration
news.summary: Speculation surrounding the pan-India project AA23, starring Allu Arjun and directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj, suggests the actor might play multiple roles including a law enforcement officer. While the collaborative venture backed by Mythri Movie Makers and featuring music by Anirudh Ravichander has not officially confirmed these character details, the script development and pre-production are progressing. Allu Arjun is currently occupied with Atlee's ambitious directorial venture Raaka before moving on to this new assignment.

news.title: Anand Deverakonda Starrer Epic Eyes Digital Premiere
news.summary: After experiencing an underwhelming theatrical run, Sithara Entertainments' Epic - First Semester is reportedly heading toward a digital release. The film, which stars Anand Deverakonda and Vaishnavi Chaitanya and marks Aditya Hasan's feature directorial debut, is anticipated to stream on October 9, 2026. Makers are also considering expanding the digital availability of the movie beyond Telugu.

news.title: Box Office Wrap: The Paradise Emerges as the Sole Bright Spot in an Underwhelming September
news.summary: The Telugu film industry experienced a largely subdued month at the box office in September 2026, with most new theatrical releases struggling to secure profits. Films like Romanchakam managed favorable digital business despite modest ticket sales, while major titles including Sardar 2 and Epic - First Semester failed to sustain their runs. Nani's The Paradise stood out as the month's highest-grossing release, accumulating around Rs 150 crore globally despite facing negative campaigns and mixed reviews.

news.title: Why Two Major Tollywood Ventures Are Giving Headaches To Mythri Movie Makers
news.summary: Prominent production banner Mythri Movie Makers is currently navigating high-pressure situations with two heavily budgeted ventures. The Prabhas-starrer Fauzi, directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, has faced extensive delays and budget escalation, while the NTR and Prashanth Neel collaboration Dragon is also grappling with production setbacks and high financial stakes.

news.title: Karthik Subbaraj Teams Up With Upendra And Prabhu Deva For Netflix Project
news.summary: Director Karthik Subbaraj disclosed details about his upcoming direct-to-OTT film for Netflix during promotions for his movie Dorothy. Adapted from a novel centered around Puliyattam, the project features Upendra, Prabhu Deva, and Atharva in major roles with filming already underway.

news.title: Yash Starrer Toxic Misses October Digital Release Slate
news.summary: The action drama Toxic, directed by Geetu Mohandas and starring Yash alongside Kiara Advani and Nayanthara, will not make its expected streaming debut in October. After an underperforming theatrical run, the movie's absence from ZEE5's latest lineup has extended the wait for fans hoping to watch it on digital platforms.
